title: Attributes Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for SOP Attributes collections, covering owner metadata, subscript lookup by attribute name, and creation of standard or custom geometric attributes.
guidance: Use this article when a script needs to resolve a SOP attribute collection such as pointAttribs, primAttribs, or vertexAttribs before accessing a specific Attribute object.
Access an attribute by name with the [] subscript operator when the attribute already exists.
Use create(name, default) for new SOP attributes; standard attributes N, uv, T, v, and Cd have implied defaults while custom attributes should supply explicit default values.
Do not present create(name, default) as a POP attribute-creation API; pair POP code generation with POP Class and POP operator cards instead.
Keep standard attributes distinct from arbitrary custom attributes so generated code does not invent incompatible defaults.
